Example Domains

Why these names exist

As described in RFC 2606 and RFC 6761, a number of domains such as example.com and example.org are maintained for documentation purposes. They are safe to use in examples because they will not resolve to a surprise third-party site.

How agents should read them

A structured read should keep this paragraph and the headings above. Cookie banners, cart links, and site chrome must not replace the article body in the excerpt an agent sees first.

Further reading lives at the IANA example-domains help page when you follow the documentation link from example.com.
